narrative.synopsis: From the aftermath of Uranus’ overthrow, foam gathers on the sea and Aphrodite rises as a new divine power. Her arrival turns cosmic violence into the entrance of beauty, attraction, and desire.
narrative.openingSituation: The sea holds the strange remnant of Uranus’ defeat.
narrative.centralConflict: A new power must emerge from an act of violence without belonging to the old household in the ordinary way.
narrative.resolution: Aphrodite reaches land and is welcomed by divine attendants.
narrative.outcome: Desire becomes an active force among gods and mortals.

events.consequence: Foam gathers around the remnant of Uranus.
The wind guides her toward shore.
Attendants receive and clothe the goddess.
Aphrodite joins the divine world as desire embodied.
